description: Lines a bill's paper carries beside its text, worded from the bill's own records: the warning the body's lawyer gives on a power the authority row marks disputed (governing phase B, gov-m3-01-city-attorney-warning-on-the-bill). Said of the body, never of the player, so it fits any bill. Also the result of a floor vote, worded from the roll call's own counts (legislation, Nov 8).

slots.lawyer: The body's lawyer by the title the records give, in lower case: city attorney, county attorney, town counsel.
slots.body: The body that would pass the bill, as the paper names it, without its article: council, County Board of Commissioners, House of Representatives. A full name may end in s, so no line makes it possessive.
slots.yes: The yes votes the roll call counted, as a number.
slots.no: The no votes the roll call counted, as a number.

parts.text: The {lawyer} warns that the {body} may not have the power to do this.
parts.author: Words session

parts.text: The lawyer for the {body} warns that it may not have the power to do this.
parts.author: Words session
